description: Source code for 'mtd', a tool for manipulating Memory Technology Devices (MTD). Includes functions for opening, checking, erasing, writing, verifying, and dumping MTD devices, as well as command-line interface handling.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function handling command-line arguments and executing corresponding MTD operations.

methods.name: mtd_open
methods.description: Open an MTD device, trying to resolve device number from /proc/mtd if possible.

methods.name: mtd_check_open
methods.description: Open MTD device and retrieve device info such as size, erasesize, and type.

methods.name: mtd_block_is_bad
methods.description: Check if a block at a given offset is bad (for NAND flash).

methods.name: mtd_erase_block
methods.description: Erase a block at a specified offset.

methods.name: mtd_write_buffer
methods.description: Write a buffer to an MTD device at a specified offset.

methods.name: image_check
methods.description: Check the magic number of an image file to determine its format.

methods.name: mtd_check
methods.description: Check and open an MTD device, supporting multiple device names separated by colons.

methods.name: mtd_unlock
methods.description: Unlock one or multiple MTD devices.

methods.name: mtd_erase
methods.description: Erase an entire MTD device, skipping bad blocks.

methods.name: mtd_dump
methods.description: Dump the contents of an MTD device to stdout.

methods.name: mtd_verify
methods.description: Verify the MD5 checksum of a file against the device contents.

methods.name: indicate_writing
methods.description: Display a message indicating data is being written to an MTD device.

methods.name: mtd_write
methods.description: Write an image file to an MTD device, handling erasing, bad blocks, and optional partition layout.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Display usage information and command options.

methods.name: do_reboot
methods.description: Reboot the system via system call or shell command.
